paper_title: Gated Attention for Large Language Models Non-linearity, Sparsity, and   Attention-Sink-Free
caption: Proportion of SDPA output values below threshold after gating (Left: 1e-2, Right: 1e-3). We also include sparsity measurements obtained by multiplying the average gating score with pre-gating hidden states.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: The graph illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output across different layers, comparing three distinct scenarios: before gate, after gate, and after average gate. The X-axis is labeled "Layer" and ranges from 0 to 23, with a linear scale and uniform intervals of 5. The Y-axis is labeled "Sparsity Ratio" and spans from 0.0 to 1.0, also with a linear scale and uniform intervals of 0.2. Three lines are plotted on the graph: a blue dashed line representing the sparsity ratio before gate with an average of 0.03, an orange dotted line for the sparsity ratio after gate with an average of 0.44, and a green dash-dotted line indicating the sparsity ratio after average gate with an average of 0.33. The blue line starts at approximately 0.18 at layer 0 and gradually decreases to around 0.01 by layer 23. The orange line begins at 1.0 at layer 0, steadily decreases to about 0.2 by layer 12, and then fluctuates between 0.2 and 0.4 from layer 13 to 23. The green line also starts at 1.0 at layer 0, drops to around 0.1 by layer 10, and remains relatively stable between 0.1 and 0.2 from layer 12 to 23, with minor fluctuations.
model_annotations.Chinese: 该图表显示了SDPA输出的稀疏性比率，使用1e-2的阈值，比较了门控前后的稀疏性比率以及平均门控后的稀疏性比率。x轴标记为“层”，具有从0到23的数值刻度，间隔为5，代表神经网络中的层数。y轴标记为“稀疏性比率”，具有从0.0到1.0的数值刻度，间隔为0.2。图表中有三条线：一条蓝色虚线代表门控前的稀疏性比率，平均值为0.03；一条橙色点线代表门控后的稀疏性比率，平均值为0.44；还有一条绿色点划线代表平均门控后的稀疏性比率，平均值为0.33。门控前的稀疏性比率（蓝色虚线）从层0时的约0.17开始，在层1时下降到约0.05，随着层数的增加逐渐下降到层23时的约0.01。门控后的稀疏性比率（橙色点线）从层0时的1.0开始，在层12时下降到约0.2，然后在层23时波动上升到约0.4。平均门控后的稀疏性比率（绿色点划线）同样从层0时的1.0开始，在层9时下降到约0.2，然后大致稳定在0.1左右，直到层23时下降到约0.05。
model_annotations.English: The plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output across different layers, with a threshold of 1e-2. The x-axis, labeled "Layer", has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 23, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Sparsity Ratio", also has a linear scale, spanning from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. Three lines are depicted in the plot: a blue dashed line representing the "sparsity ratio before gate" with an average value of 0.03, which starts at approximately 0.16 at layer 0 and decreases to around 0.01 at layer 23; an orange dotted line representing the "sparsity ratio after gate" with an average value of 0.44, which begins at 1.0 at layer 0, declines to around 0.2 at layer 10, and then fluctuates between 0.2 and 0.4 from layer 11 to 23; and a green dash-dot line representing the "sparsity ratio after average gate" with an average value of 0.33, which starts at 1.0 at layer 0, decreases to approximately 0.1 at layer 10, and then remains relatively stable, ranging from 0.1 to 0.15, from layer 11 to 20 before dropping to around 0.05 at layer 23.
model_annotations.German: The diagram illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output at a threshold of 1e-2. The x-axis and y-axis represent the layer and sparsity ratio, respectively, with the x-axis ranging from 0 to 22 in intervals of roughly 5 and the y-axis ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 in intervals of 0.2. Three distinct lines are plotted: a blue dashed line representing the sparsity ratio before the gate, an orange dotted line representing the sparsity ratio after the gate, and a green dash-dotted line representing the sparsity ratio after the average gate. The blue line starts at approximately 0.18 at layer 0 and decreases to around 0.01 at layer 22. The orange line begins at 1.0 at layer 0, decreases to 0.2 at layer 10, and then fluctuates between 0.2 and 0.4 from layer 12 to 22. The green line starts at 1.0 at layer 0, decreases to 0.1 at layer 10, remains relatively stable around 0.1 from layer 12 to 18, and then decreases to around 0.05 at layer 22.
